*** START OF THE PROJECT GUTENBERG EBOOK FIXTURE ESCOFFIER ***

Title: A Fixture Guide to Modern Cookery

THE FIVE MOTHER SAUCES

Sauces are the foundation of cookery. A good brown stock, long and gently simmered, gives body to the espagnole. Skim the stock often and never allow it to boil hard, or it will turn cloudy.

Roux is equal parts flour and butter by weight, cooked until the raw taste of the flour is gone. A white roux is cooked briefly, a brown roux until it takes a nutty color.

HOLDING COOKED MEAT

It was once said that cooked meat may stand in a warm kitchen all day without harm. This advice should not be followed.
